quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #14
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join the traffic flow.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join the traffic flow.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side view. Move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: When merging onto the freeway, you should drive:

options.text: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
5 to 10 mph slower than freeway traffic.
At the posted speed limit for the freeway.

questions.correctAnswerText: At or near the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Merge onto the freeway at or near the same speed as the traffic already on the road.

questions.question: In fog, you should use high beam headlights to see better.
questions.explanation: In fog, use low beam headlights or fog lights. High beams reflect off the fog and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you to slow down because wet pavement makes it harder to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: To make room for cars entering the freeway, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed and position the same.

questions.explanation: If possible, change lanes to create a gap for incoming vehicles. If you cannot change lanes, adjust your speed to let them merge safely.

questions.question: If oncoming headlights blind you at night, you should:

options.text: Look toward the right edge of the road.
Turn your lights on and off.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right edge of the road.
questions.explanation: Look at the right edge of the road instead of straight ahead. This keeps your car on the road until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: When a red light and green arrow are shown together, you cannot turn in the arrow's direction until the red light changes.
questions.explanation: You can turn in the direction of the green arrow after checking that the intersection and crosswalk are clear. Other lights shown do not stop you from turning on the arrow.

questions.question: Drivers age 18 and older can use cellphones while driving if they use a hands-free device.
questions.explanation: Handheld cellphones and texting are not allowed while driving. Hands-free devices and Bluetooth are permitted for drivers age 19 and older.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: Can anyone wear a dual ear headset while driving?
questions.explanation: In Illinois, it is illegal to wear a dual ear headset while driving. You can use a single earpiece with a wireless phone. Motorcycle riders can use intercom helmets.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the intersection is safe and clear.

questions.question: When parallel parking facing downhill, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels sharply toward the side of the road.
Turn your wheels away from the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels sharply toward the side of the road.
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your front wheels toward the curb or road edge. This prevents your car from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail.

questions.question: Does talking or texting on a cell phone while driving increase your crash risk?
questions.explanation: Using a phone while driving is a distraction. It increases your risk of crashing.

questions.question: What does this orange triangle symbol mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road splits. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing without a signal. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: Slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: While in a motor vehicle on a highway, what is legal?

options.text: Illegal to either drink from or possess open containers of alcohol.
Legal to drink alcohol if you're not driving.
Legal to drink alcohol if you're driving but not drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Illegal to either drink from or possess open containers of alcohol.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink alcohol or have an open container in a running vehicle. Neither drivers nor passengers can do this.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction zones. Drive with caution.

questions.question: Can you pass on a two-lane road within 100 feet of an intersection or railroad crossing?
questions.explanation: You cannot pass on a two-lane road within 100 feet of an intersection or railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: Who must drivers turning left yield to?

options.text: Oncoming vehicles traveling straight or turning right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Oncoming vehicles traveling straight or turning right.
questions.explanation: Drivers turning left must yield to all vehicles coming toward them from the opposite direction. This includes bicycles and motorcycles.

questions.question: When a train is approaching, how far from the nearest rail must all vehicles stop?
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, stop within 15 to 50 feet if you see a stop sign, flashing lights, a lowered gate, a flagger's signal, or an approaching train.

questions.question: After a train passes at a railroad crossing, what should you do?

options.text: Wait for signal lights to stop flashing.

questions.explanation: After a train passes, watch for a second train on any track. Do not drive until all gates are raised and all warning lights have stopped flashing.

questions.question: Can you pass on a two-lane road with a solid yellow line on your side?
questions.explanation: You can only pass when the broken yellow line is on your side of the road. A solid yellow line on your side means no passing.

questions.question: What is the proper way to make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and get into the lane closest to the centerline before turning.
Signal, slow down, and get into the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Approach the corner in the lane nearest the right curb, but move over toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and get into the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, signal to warn other drivers. Slow down and stay in the right lane as close to the right curb as possible.

questions.question: When weather or light conditions require your lights on, which lights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, snow, or rain. High beams reflect light back at you, making it harder to see.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow centerline mean?

options.text: Passing on the right is permitted when the way ahead is clear.
Passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means you can pass on the left if the road ahead is clear. Never cross a solid yellow line to pass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce speed in wet conditions.

questions.question: If your tire blows out, you should brake quickly and pull off the road to check it.
questions.explanation: If your tire blows out, ease off the gas pedal. Keep a firm grip on the steering wheel. Pull safely off the road and check your tires. Do not brake suddenly.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limits.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roadways where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: On a freeway, you should look farther ahead than on a city street:

options.text: Because it takes a quarter mile to stop your vehicle completely.

questions.explanation: On the freeway, be ready for changes in traffic. Watch for signals from other drivers. Expect vehicles merging at on-ramps and be prepared for quick changes in road and traffic conditions.

questions.question: If you face a green traffic light but the intersection is blocked, you should:

options.text: Turn left and find another route.
Wait until traffic clears before entering the intersection.
Follow other vehicles and enter the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until traffic clears before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, do not enter the intersection if vehicles are blocking your way. If the light turns red while you are stuck in the intersection, you block cross traffic. You can get a ticket for this.
